welcome_subtitle: Storage Organisation Kit - Your media library, perfectly organized.
file_mode_hint: A hard link leaves the original in place, so torrents keep seeding, without using more space. The destination must be on the same drive.
hard_link_impossible_text: S.O.K cannot make hard links from “{0}” to “{1}”: both must be on the same drive, on a disk that supports hard links. Choose a destination on that drive, or the Move or Copy file mode in the settings.
custom_key_tooltip: A key is already included. Enter a value only to use your own key.
reset_confirm: Do you really want to reset all settings?
disconnect_confirm: Do you really want to disconnect from this service?
api_key_needed_msg: To connect to {name}, you need an API key.
open_url_confirm: Do you want to open {name} to create an API key?
drag_drop_folder: Drag and drop a folder or click
movies_drop_hint: Drop video files or folders, or click to browse
no_movies_ready: No movies are ready to rename.
drag_drop_files: Drag and drop files or click
drag_drop_dest_folder: Drop the destination folder here or click to choose
download_link_not_found: Unable to find the download link.
error_api_key: {service}: the API key is missing or wrong. Check it in {where}.
error_api_quota_wait: {service}: too many requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
error_api_quota: {service}: too many requests, or the quota of the day is used. Try again later.
error_api_timeout: {service} did not answer in time. Try again.
error_api_connection: Cannot reach {service}. Check your internet connection.
error_api_response: {service} returned an error. Try again later.
drop_anything_hint: Drop files or folders here, or click to choose a folder
drop_reason_season_folder: In a season folder, without an episode number
drop_reason_disc_image: Disc image: a game or a video disc?
drop_nothing_found: No media file recognized. Accepted files: {extensions}. Archives, programs and text documents are only accepted in the page of their type.
drop_error: The files could not be analyzed: {error}
rename_skips_to_pick: {0} file(s) still to pick will be left as they are.
batch_drop_hint: Drop files or folders, or click to browse
nothing_ready: No file is ready to rename.
books_drop_hint: Drop book files or folders, or click to browse
games_drop_hint: Drop game files or folders, or click to browse
tracks_drop_hint: Drop audio files or folders, or click to browse
input_formats_help: Describe how your file names are built, with the variables of the output formats. Your patterns are tried before the ones S.O.K knows. {ignore} skips a part of the name.
pattern_error_braces: A brace { or } is not closed.
pattern_exists: This pattern is already in the list
input_test_no_type: Add the extension of the file (.mkv, .mp3, .epub…)
history_confirm_undo: Put {0} file(s) back where they were?
history_confirm_clear: Clear the history? The renames can no longer be undone. The files stay where they are.
undo_missing: moved or deleted since the rename
undo_occupied: another file has its old name
web_setup_text: Create the account that protects this server.
web_auth_off: The login is turned off (SOK_AUTH=none): protect this server with your reverse proxy.
web_error_invalid_account: Give a user name, and a password of 8 characters or more.
web_error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
web_error_password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
web_error_invalid_folder: “{item}” is not a folder the server can see. Give its full path, as mounted in the container.
web_error_key_locked: An environment variable sets this key: change it there.
web_file_mode_copy_hint: The original stays in place and a copy is renamed: it takes the space twice.
web_file_mode_move_hint: The file leaves the downloads: a torrent of it stops seeding.
web_folders_text: The paths as the server sees them: in Docker, the folders mounted in the container.
web_key_replace: New key, to replace the current one…
web_key_service_error: The service answered with an error
web_keys_text: The free services work without a key. A key typed here is kept encrypted on the server, and never sent back.
web_language_text: The interface and the names of the folders (“Season”).
web_link_different_drives: “{source}” and “{destination}” are on two drives, or two Docker mounts: mount their common parent folder once.
web_link_no_hard_links: The disk of “{destination}” has no hard links (FAT, exFAT, most network shares).
web_error_already_running: An analysis or a rename is already running.
web_error_no_sources: Add a source folder in the settings first.
web_error_rename_running: A rename is running: wait for its end.
web_error_scan_running: An analysis is running: wait for its end.
web_no_analysis: No analysis yet: analyze the source folders to fill the tabs.
web_no_rows: Nothing here yet: analyze the source folders.
web_pick_text: Pick the right result, or search another title.
web_processed_hidden: {n} files already processed are left out.
web_scan_interrupted: The last analysis was cut by a restart of the server: analyze again.
web_stop_key_refused: {service} refused the key: check it in the settings.
web_stop_missing_key: {service}: the key is missing. Add it in the settings, then analyze again.
web_stop_rate_limited: {service}: too many requests, or the quota is used. Try again later.
web_to_check_text: Their type is a guess: confirm it, or pick another one.
web_error_no_destination: Add a destination folder for this type in the settings first.
web_processed_text: Renamed with a hard link or a copy, these files stay in the downloads: the analyses leave them out while they do not change. Analyze one again to rename it once more.
web_see_history: See the history, to undo it
web_choose_folder: Choose a folder of the server
web_error_unreadable_folder: The server cannot read this folder.
web_link_problem_text: Files cannot be renamed with a hard link between these folders: the rename would stop before moving anything.
web_link_fix_different_drives: mount the folder that holds both of them once in the container (for example /mnt/storage:/data), then choose them under /data. On two real disks, choose a destination on the disk of the downloads.
web_link_fix_no_hard_links: choose a destination on a disk that has hard links (ext4, Btrfs, XFS, ZFS, NTFS, APFS), or the Copy mode.
web_link_fix_missing_folder: check that the folder still exists, and that it is mounted in the container.
web_link_problems: Hard links will not work between some of your folders.
web_auto_sort_text: The server looks at the source folders on its own. Once downloaded, the new files are analyzed and the Ready ones renamed; the others wait in the tabs.
web_auto_sort_confirm_detail: Every Ready row will be renamed on its own, those already in the tabs too, with the file mode “{mode}”. The history can undo it.
web_notifications_text: After each rename, by hand or automatic, S.O.K Server can tell your other apps.
web_notify_discord_text: A message in a channel. Webhook address: settings of the channel → Integrations → Webhooks.
web_notify_jellyfin_text: Refreshes the libraries. API key: Dashboard → API Keys.
web_notify_plex_text: Refreshes the libraries, with your Plex token.
web_notify_webhook_text: The rename as JSON, for Home Assistant, n8n and other tools.
web_notify_script_set: Set by the SOK_AFTER_RENAME variable: it runs after each rename, with the rename as JSON on its input.
web_notify_script_text: A command run after each rename, with the rename as JSON on its input. For safety, only the SOK_AFTER_RENAME variable of the container sets it.
web_notify_replace: Saved: type a new one to replace it…
web_error_invalid_url: Give an address that starts with http:// or https://.
web_theme_text: In this browser. System: dark or light like the device; the light theme is white on a Mac, orange elsewhere.
web_links_ok: Hard links work between your folders.
